record.office: Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Ohio
record.t: Was elected Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Ohio in November 2022 and is the eleventh Chief Justice (2023).
record.q: Sharon L. Kennedy was elected Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Ohio in November 2022. She is the eleventh Chief Justice and the second woman to serve in the role.
